major_trade_goods: Black pepper ('black gold'), beryl, pearls, malabathrum, exported in exchange for Roman gold, wine, and Mediterranean pottery (amphorae)
contemporary_foreign_accounts: Periplus of the Erythraean Sea, Pliny the Elder's Natural History, and the Tabula Peutingeriana
archaeological_findings: Pattanam excavations unearthed Roman amphorae shards, terra sigillata, roulette ware, and Roman coins
